name: A Helping Hand
source:
The protagonist is a lower-ranking Proxy who is assigned minor tasks by the others. Each day offers several requests that can be accepted or declined, giving the protagonist opportunities to speak with fellow Proxies and improve their relationships.

The current demo covers the first of five planned days and features Kate the Chaser, Eyeless Jack, and Ticci Toby.
